recipes.title: Shakshuka with Feta and Fresh Herbs
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on medium-low for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Crumble feta cheese over the top and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve immediately from the skillet with soft pita or crusty-free bread.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Soft Figs and Seeds
instructions: Divide Greek yogurt between two bowls.
Drizzle honey generously over each portion.
Top with quartered soft dried figs and sunflower seeds.
Dust with a pinch of ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tortilla Española (Spanish Potato Omelette)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Gently fry potato slices and onion in the oil, turning occasionally, until potatoes are very tender but not browned, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat eggs in a large bowl with salt and pepper.
Drain potatoes and onion, reserving oil. Fold the potato mixture into the beaten eggs and let sit 5 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of reserved oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour in the egg-potato mixture, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until the bottom is set and golden, about 5 minutes.
Place a large plate over the skillet and carefully flip the tortilla onto the plate, then slide it back into the skillet.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes until just set in the center.
Slide onto a cutting board, let rest 5 minutes, then slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen (Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes and Peppers)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add diced green peppers and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and salt. Cook until tomatoes break down into a sauce, about 7 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and pour in beaten eggs, stirring gently to create soft curds mixed throughout the tomato sauce.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are just set but still creamy, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Moroccan Semolina Breakfast Porridge (Herbel)
instructions: Bring water with salt to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Gradually whisk in the semolina, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in butter, honey, cinnamon, and orange blossom water if using.
Serve warm in bowls, drizzled with additional honey if desired.

recipes.title: Labneh Toast with Za'atar and Soft Roasted Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss cherry tomato halves with 1 tablespoon olive oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until tomatoes are soft and slightly blistered.
Lightly toast the bread slices just until warmed (keep them soft, not crunchy).
Spread a generous layer of labneh on each slice.
Top with roasted tomatoes, sprinkle with za'atar, and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Italian Egg and Ricotta Bake with Spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Sauté garlic in a skillet for 30 seconds, add spinach and wilt completely. Drain any excess liquid.
Whisk eggs with ricotta, half the parmesan, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Fold in wilted spinach and chopped sun-dried tomatoes.
Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish and top with remaining parmesan.
Bake for 22-25 minutes until puffed and set in the center.
Let cool 5 minutes, top with fresh basil leaves, and serve in squares.

recipes.title: Ful Medames (Egyptian Mashed Fava Beans)
instructions: Place drained fava beans in a saucepan with 0.5 cup water. Heat over medium until simmering.
Mash about half the beans with a fork, leaving some whole for texture.
Stir in garlic, cumin, lemon juice, and salt. Cook 5 more minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle generously with olive oil and tahini if using.
Top with diced tomato and fresh parsley. Serve warm with soft flatbread.

recipes.title: Savory French Mediterranean Crêpes with Ratatouille Filling
instructions: Blend flour, eggs, milk, water, melted butter, and salt until smooth. Refrigerate batter 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet. Sauté eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper until very soft, about 10 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and herbes de Provence. Simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Heat a lightly buttered non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter, swirling to coat the pan.
Cook crêpe until edges lift easily, about 1 minute per side.
Repeat with remaining batter to make 8 crêpes.
Fill each crêpe with the warm ratatouille filling, fold, top with shredded Gruyère, and serve.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Chickpea Breakfast Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas with 2 cups of water, cumin, harissa paste, and salt.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, mashing some chickpeas to thicken the broth.
Meanwhile, soft-boil eggs for 6 minutes, then peel and halve.
Place torn bread in serving bowls. Ladle the hot chickpea stew over the bread so it softens completely.
Top each bowl with a halved soft-boiled egg, a drizzle of olive oil, lemon juice, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Pastitsio (Greek Baked Pasta with Meat Sauce)
instructions: Cook penne pasta until al dente, drain, and toss with a little olive oil.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil and brown ground lamb over medium-high heat, breaking it up.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened. Stir in tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in nutmeg and egg yolks.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Layer half the pasta in a greased 9x13 baking dish, top with all the meat sauce, then remaining pasta.
Pour béchamel evenly over top and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 35-40 minutes until golden and bubbling. Let rest 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Imam Bayildi (Turkish Stuffed Eggplant)
instructions: Halve eggplants lengthwise and score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern. Salt generously and let sit 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet and sear eggplant halves cut-side down until golden. Transfer to a baking dish.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil. Sauté onions until very soft and golden, about 12 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes, parsley, sugar, lemon juice, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
Spoon the onion-tomato mixture generously over each eggplant half.
Add 0.5 cup water to the baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40-45 minutes until eggplant is completely tender.
Serve warm or at room temperature, drizzled with additional olive oil.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemons and Olives
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt, turmeric, cumin, and saffron.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown chicken on both sides, about 8 minutes total. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat, add grated onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, add chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low for 40 minutes until chicken is fall-off-the-bone tender.
Add preserved lemon slices and green olives, cook uncovered 10 more minutes.
Garnish generously with fresh cilantro and serve over fluffy couscous.

recipes.title: Dolmas (Stuffed Grape Leaves with Rice and Herbs)
instructions: Soak rice in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain well.
Mix rice with diced onion, 2 tablespoons olive oil, all fresh herbs, tomato paste, half the lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Lay a grape leaf flat, vein-side up. Place 1 tablespoon of filling near the stem end.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly from stem to tip. Repeat with remaining leaves and filling.
Line the bottom of a pot with any torn or extra grape leaves.
Arrange dolmas seam-side down in tight concentric circles. Layer if needed.
Mix water with remaining olive oil and lemon juice, pour over dolmas.
Place a heavy plate on top to keep dolmas submerged. Cover and simmer gently for 45 minutes.
Let cool in the pot before serving at room temperature with yogurt on the side.

recipes.title: Turkish Lamb Kofte with Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Combine ground lamb, grated onion (squeeze out excess liquid), garlic, cumin, paprika, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix well.
Form mixture into oval-shaped kofte, about 2 inches long. You should get about 16 pieces.
Mix yogurt with lemon juice, mint, and a pinch of salt for the sauce.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook kofte for 3-4 minutes per side until well-browned outside and cooked through.
Serve kofte over warm soft flatbread or rice with the yogurt-mint sauce drizzled over top.

recipes.title: Soft Fattoush Salad with Sumac Dressing

ingredients.displayName: Soft Pita Bread, torn into pieces

instructions: Warm pita bread briefly in the oven just until soft and pliable (not toasted crispy), then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Combine lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, radishes, green onions, mint, and parsley in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, sumac, pomegranate molasses if using, and salt.
Add soft pita pieces to the salad, pour dressing over, and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately while the pita is still soft, sprinkled with extra sumac.

recipes.title: Seafood Paella Valenciana
instructions: Bloom saffron in 2 tablespoons of warm stock for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a wide paella pan or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add grated tomato and smoked paprika, cook 3 minutes.
Add rice, stirring to coat in the sauce. Pour in warm fish stock and saffron liquid. Season with salt.
Arrange rice evenly, bring to a boil, then reduce to medium. Do not stir from this point.
After 12 minutes, nestle shrimp and calamari into the rice. Arrange mussels hinge-side down on top.
Scatter peas over everything. Cook 8-10 more minutes until rice is tender, mussels have opened, and shrimp are pink.
Remove from heat, cover with a towel, and rest 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Orzo with Artichokes and Peas

ingredients.displayName: Canned Artichoke Hearts, drained and quartered

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add orzo and stir to coat in oil. Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until orzo is almost tender.
Add artichoke hearts and peas, cook 3 more minutes.
Stir in cream cheese, parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh dill, and serve warm.

recipes.title: Lebanese Kibbeh Bil Sanieh (Baked Kibbeh)
instructions: Soak fine bulgur in cold water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
In a food processor, blend soaked bulgur, half the lamb, quartered onion, allspice, cinnamon, cumin, salt, and pepper into a smooth paste.
For the filling: heat 1 tablespoon oil, sauté diced onion until soft, add ground beef and remaining lamb, cook until browned. Add sunflower seeds and season well.
Press half the bulgur-lamb mixture evenly into a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Spread the cooked meat filling evenly over the base layer.
Top with remaining bulgur-lamb mixture, pressing gently and smoothing the surface.
Score the top into diamond shapes with a sharp knife. Drizzle generously with olive oil.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving with yogurt and a simple salad.

recipes.title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Salt eggplant slices, let sit 20 minutes, pat dry. Brush with olive oil and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until soft.
Parboil potato slices for 5 minutes until just tender, drain.
Brown ground lamb in a large skillet, drain excess fat. Add onion and garlic, cook until soft.
Add wine, crushed tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk, whisk until thick. Remove from heat, stir in egg yolks and nutmeg.
Layer in a 9x13 dish: potatoes, then eggplant, then meat sauce.
Pour béchamel over top, sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest 20 minutes before cutting into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh (Fine-Chopped Parsley and Bulgur Salad)

ingredients.displayName: Fresh Flat-Leaf Parsley, very finely chopped

instructions: Soak fine bulgur in warm water for 15 minutes until tender. Drain thoroughly, pressing out all water.
In a large bowl, combine the very finely chopped parsley, mint, diced tomatoes, and green onions.
Add the drained bulgur and toss to combine.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and allspice if using.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
Let sit for 10 minutes for flavors to meld. Serve at room temperature, scooping with soft lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Italian Caprese Pasta Salad with Fresh Mozzarella
instructions: Cook fusilli in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and rinse with cool water.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine pasta, mozzarella cubes, halved cherry tomatoes, and torn basil.
Pour dressing over and toss gently to combine.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled. Flavors improve after 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Soft-Cooked Broccoli
instructions: Cook spaghetti in heavily salted boiling water until al dente. Add broccoli florets in the last 3 minutes so they become very soft. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking gently until garlic is golden (not browned), about 3 minutes.
Add drained spaghetti and soft broccoli to the skillet. Toss vigorously with 0.5 cup reserved pasta water.
Add lemon juice and parsley, toss again, adding more pasta water if needed for a silky sauce.
Serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Lamb and Apricot Tagine with Couscous
instructions: Season lamb cubes with salt, cumin, coriander, and turmeric.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown lamb in batches, set aside.
Sauté onion until golden, add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute.
Return lamb, add cinnamon stick, broth, and honey. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 1 hour until lamb is nearly tender.
Add dried apricots and cook 30 more minutes until lamb is fall-apart tender and apricots are plump.
Meanwhile, prepare couscous by pouring 1.5 cups boiling salted water over couscous, cover and let sit 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Serve tagine over fluffy couscous, garnished with cilantro.

recipes.title: French Bouillabaisse (Provençal Seafood Stew)

ingredients.displayName: Firm White Fish (cod or halibut), cubed

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion, leek, and fennel until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, fish stock, saffron, orange peel, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook 15 minutes for flavors to develop.
Add the cubed firm fish and cook 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and mussels, cover and cook 5-7 minutes until mussels open and shrimp are pink.
Discard any unopened mussels and the orange peel.
Ladle into warm bowls, garnish with parsley, and serve with a side of soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Classic French Ratatouille

ingredients.displayName: Yellow Squash, sliced into thin rounds
Roma Tomatoes, sliced into thin rounds

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a skillet, sauté diced onion and bell pepper in 1 tablespoon olive oil until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, half the herbes de Provence, salt, and pepper. Spread this sauce evenly in a baking dish.
Arrange alternating slices of eggplant, zucchini, yellow squash, and tomato in tight concentric circles over the sauce.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with remaining herbes de Provence.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes until vegetables are very soft.
Top with fresh basil and serve warm.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon-Dill Yogurt and Soft Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange zucchini slices and cherry tomatoes on a sheet pan. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Place salmon fillets on top of the vegetables, drizzle with remaining oil, and lay lemon slices on top.
Bake 20-25 minutes until salmon flakes easily and vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, mix yogurt with lemon juice, minced garlic, 2 tablespoons chopped dill, and a pinch of salt.
Serve salmon and vegetables with a generous dollop of lemon-dill yogurt, garnished with remaining dill.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, garlic, and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken thighs 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through (internal temp 165°F).
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini with 3 tablespoons water, a squeeze of lemon, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Assemble bowls with rice, sliced chicken, diced cucumber, diced tomato, and pickled turnips if using.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Risotto ai Funghi (Italian Mushroom Risotto)
instructions: Soak dried porcini in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes. Strain, reserving the liquid. Chop porcini.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat.
Sauté fresh mushrooms with thyme until golden and tender, about 6 minutes. Add porcini, cook 1 minute. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon butter, sauté shallot until translucent. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until edges are translucent.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Begin adding warm broth and porcini liquid, one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next.
Continue for about 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat, stir in remaining butter, parmesan, and reserved mushrooms.
Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Turkish Pide with Spiced Ground Beef
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and 1 teaspoon salt, add yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Knead into a soft dough, about 5 minutes. Cover and rest 30 minutes.
Mix raw ground beef with onion, pepper, tomato, tomato paste, cumin, red pepper flakes, and remaining salt.
Divide dough into 4 pieces. Roll each into an oval shape, about 10 inches long.
Place on parchment-lined baking sheets. Spread meat mixture over each, leaving a border.
Fold and pinch the edges up to create a boat shape.
Bake at 475°F (245°C) for 12-15 minutes until dough is cooked and meat is done.
Optionally crack an egg into the center of each pide in the last 3 minutes of baking.
Brush edges with melted butter and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Penne alla Vodka with Soft Roasted Tomatoes
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté shallot until softened, add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 1 minute.
Carefully add vodka and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer 5 more minutes until sauce is silky and pink.
Add drained penne and half the parmesan. Toss, adding pasta water as needed for the right consistency.
Serve topped with remaining parmesan and torn fresh basil.

recipes.title: Greek Braised Chicken with Lemon and Soft Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Arrange chicken and quartered potatoes in a large roasting pan.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and broth. Scatter garlic around the pan.
Pour the liquid over chicken and potatoes.
Roast for 55-60 minutes, basting halfway through, until chicken is golden and potatoes are very soft.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the pan juices spooned over top.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli Rabe, Sausage, and Garlic
instructions: Cook orecchiette in salted boiling water. Add chopped broccoli rabe in the last 3 minutes to cook until very tender. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain together.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet. Crumble in sausage and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining olive oil. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook gently until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and broccoli rabe, the cooked sausage, and 0.5 cup pasta water.
Toss everything together over medium heat. Add lemon juice and more pasta water as needed.
Serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Spanish Braised Chickpeas with Spinach and Smoked Paprika
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and crushed tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens and chickpeas are very tender.
Add spinach in large handfuls, stirring until wilted.
Finish with sherry vinegar and a final drizzle of olive oil.
Serve warm with soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Moroccan Vegetable Couscous with Seven Vegetables
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened.
Add ras el hanout, turmeric, and cinnamon stick, stirring for 1 minute.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Add sweet potato, turnip, and tomatoes.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add zucchini, cabbage, and chickpeas.
Continue simmering 20 minutes until all vegetables are very tender.
Meanwhile, prepare couscous by pouring 2 cups boiling salted water over couscous, covering, and letting sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Mound couscous on a large platter, ladle the vegetable stew over and around.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with harissa on the side for added heat.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Lamb Shanks with Red Wine and Rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C). Season lamb shanks generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear lamb shanks on all sides until deeply browned, about 8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Pour in red wine and scrape up any browned bits. Let reduce by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, rosemary, and bay leaves. Return lamb shanks to the pot.
Cover and transfer to oven. Braise for 2-2.5 hours until lamb is completely fall-off-the-bone tender.
Remove shanks and discard rosemary sprigs and bay leaves. If sauce is thin, simmer on stovetop to reduce.
Serve lamb shanks over soft polenta or mashed potatoes with the braising sauce.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice, Herbs, and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cut the tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. Blanch peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes to soften. Drain upside down.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Cook onion until soft, add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess fat.
Stir in cooked rice, parsley, mint, cumin, allspice, salt, pepper, and 0.5 cup tomato sauce.
Stuff each bell pepper with the mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Pour remaining tomato sauce around the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35-40 minutes until peppers are very tender.
Uncover for the last 10 minutes. Serve with the sauce spooned over top.

recipes.title: Linguine alle Vongole (Pasta with Clams)
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until 1 minute short of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, drain.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes.
Pour in white wine and bring to a boil. Add clams, cover, and cook 5-7 minutes until all clams open. Discard any that don't open.
Add the drained linguine to the skillet with the clams. Toss over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of pasta water to create a glossy sauce.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley. Toss once more and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan (Melanzane alla Parmigiana)
instructions: Salt eggplant slices, let sit 20 minutes, then pat completely dry.
Brush both sides with olive oil and bake on sheet pans at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes until soft.
Make sauce: sauté garlic in remaining olive oil for 1 minute, add crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, pepper, and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce oven to 375°F (190°C).
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer eggplant, sauce, mozzarella slices, parmesan, and basil. Repeat layers.
Finish with sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan on top.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Rest 15 minutes before slicing. Garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.title: Fasolada (Greek White Bean Soup)

ingredients.displayName: Dried Great Northern Beans, soaked overnight

instructions: Drain soaked beans, place in a large pot, cover with fresh water, and boil for 10 minutes. Drain.
In the same pot, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and oregano. Cook 1 minute.
Add beans, crushed tomatoes, bay leaves, and 8 cups water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer gently for 50-60 minutes until beans are very soft and creamy.
Discard bay leaves. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in deep bowls with a generous drizzle of remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Spanish Gazpacho (Chilled Tomato Soup)
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper.
Soak the bread in water for 1 minute, then squeeze dry.
Place all vegetables, soaked bread, garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar, salt, and pepper in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth, at least 1 minute.
Strain through a fine sieve for ultra-smooth texture if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
Serve cold in chilled bowls with a drizzle of olive oil and diced cucumber garnish.

recipes.title: Italian Minestrone with Soft Pasta
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add zucchini and green beans, cook 3 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Add ditalini pasta and both beans. Reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes until pasta and vegetables are very soft.
Stir in baby spinach until wilted.
Discard bay leaf. Ladle into bowls and finish with a drizzle of good olive oil.
Serve with parmesan on the side for non-vegan option.

recipes.title: Turkish Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek Çorbası)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrot, potato, and garlic. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, 1 teaspoon cumin, and half the paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer 20-25 minutes until lentils and vegetables are completely soft.
Blend the soup with an immersion blender until velvety smooth.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt.
In a small pan, melt butter and stir in remaining cumin, paprika, and red pepper flakes until fragrant.
Ladle soup into bowls and drizzle with the spiced butter. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Moroccan Harira (Chickpea and Tomato Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, and cumin. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground lamb, breaking up with a spoon, and cook until browned.
Add crushed tomatoes, chickpeas, lentils, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 35-40 minutes until lentils are completely soft.
Stir in cilantro, parsley, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and serve in deep bowls with soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Cauliflower Soup with Za'atar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss cauliflower with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 25 minutes until very soft and golden.
Heat remaining oil in a large pot. Sauté onion until soft, add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add roasted cauliflower and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in yogurt and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Ladle into bowls, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with za'atar.

recipes.title: Avgolemono (Greek Lemon Chicken Soup)
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Add chicken breast, reduce to a simmer, and poach for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Keep broth simmering.
Add rice to the broth and cook 15 minutes until very tender.
In a bowl, whisk eggs until frothy. While whisking constantly, slowly ladle 2 cups of the hot broth into the eggs to temper them.
Pour the egg-broth mixture back into the pot, stirring constantly. Do not boil.
Add lemon juice, lemon zest, and shredded chicken. Stir until soup is creamy and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and white pepper. Serve garnished with fresh dill.

recipes.title: Creamy Hummus
instructions: Process tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute until thick and creamy.
Add garlic, cumin, and salt. Process 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and process 1 minute.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil and ice water. Process a full 3-4 minutes until extremely smooth and fluffy.
Taste and adjust salt and lemon.
Transfer to a serving bowl, create a well in the center, drizzle with olive oil, and dust with paprika.
Serve with warm soft pita bread.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush (Smoky Eggplant Dip)
instructions: Prick eggplants all over with a fork. Char directly over a gas flame or under a broiler, turning frequently, until skin is blackened and flesh is completely collapsed, about 15-20 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then peel off the charred skin and drain the flesh in a colander for 10 minutes.
Mash the eggplant flesh with a fork (for rustic texture) or pulse briefly in a food processor.
Stir in tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, smoked paprika, and salt.
Transfer to a serving plate, drizzle with olive oil, and garnish with parsley and pomegranate seeds if using.

recipes.title: Greek Tzatziki Sauce

ingredients.displayName: English Cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

instructions: Grate cucumber on the large holes of a box grater. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and let sit 5 minutes.
Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean towel to remove as much liquid as possible.
In a bowl, combine yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill, and mint if using.
Season with salt and white pepper. Mix well.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving for best flavor.
Drizzle with a little olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Soft Braised Fennel with Parmesan
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Place fennel quarters cut-side down and sear until lightly golden, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic, white wine, and broth. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and braise over low heat for 20-25 minutes until fennel is completely soft and translucent.
Remove lid, increase heat to reduce any remaining liquid to a glaze.
Drizzle with lemon juice and top with shaved parmesan. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Salade Niçoise (Tender Composed Salad)
instructions: Boil potatoes until very tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and halve.
Cook green beans in salted boiling water for 5 minutes until very tender (not crisp). Transfer to ice water briefly, then drain.
Soft-boil eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in ice water, then peel and halve.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, and salt for the dressing.
Arrange potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, tuna, eggs, olives, and red onion on a platter.
Drizzle with the vinaigrette and scatter fresh basil over the top.
Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Italian Marinated White Beans with Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Canned Cannellini Beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Gently toss drained beans with olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Add red onion, parsley, and basil. Season with salt and pepper.
Let marinate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes (up to 2 hours) before serving.
Serve as a side dish or spoon over soft bread.

recipes.title: Muhammara (Roasted Red Pepper and Seed Dip)
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a food processor and pulse until finely ground (but not a paste).
Add roasted red peppers, breadcrumbs, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Process until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil until well combined.
Transfer to a bowl, drizzle with a little more olive oil, and serve with warm soft pita.

recipes.title: Spanakopita Bites (Spinach and Feta Phyllo Rolls)

ingredients.displayName: Frozen Spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

instructions: Mix spinach, feta, ricotta, green onions, egg, dill, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Lay one sheet of phyllo on a work surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Spoon a line of filling along the long edge and roll up into a cylinder. Cut into 2-inch pieces.
Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling.
Place pieces seam-side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush tops with butter.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 18-20 minutes until golden and the layers are soft-flaky (not hard).
Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Labneh Balls Marinated in Olive Oil and Herbs
instructions: Line a sieve with cheesecloth over a bowl. Place labneh in cheesecloth, gather edges, and refrigerate to drain further for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Roll the thickened labneh into small balls, about 1 tablespoon each. You should get about 20-24 balls.
Place labneh balls in a clean jar.
Add garlic slices, lemon peel, thyme, rosemary, za'atar, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Pour olive oil over to completely cover the balls.
Seal and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
Serve at room temperature with soft warm bread, spooning some of the flavored oil alongside.
